scripts.render: remotion render Promo916 out/barker-promo-9x16.mp4 && remotion render Promo169 out/barker-promo-16x9.mp4 && npm run beat
scripts.beat: node tools/beat.mjs out/beat.wav && ffmpeg -y -i out/barker-promo-9x16.mp4 -i out/beat.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest out/barker-promo-9x16-beat.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -i out/barker-promo-16x9.mp4 -i out/beat.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -shortest out/barker-promo-16x9-beat.mp4
